comments.author: home
comments.text:
The two account/perspective names supplied by the user are already known; do not request the names again or create duplicate organizations. Read-only tracing verified that the live central router and configured publication clients use the same production account directory. Its inspected records do not establish the required named-identity mapping. The existing Data Parade product uses a separate organization/workspace identity model, and no authoritative crosswalk was found.

The smallest unresolved identity input is the product/account-picker page that displays the two known names, or equivalent authenticated metadata. Keep exact private identity readback outside the public repository. Data Parade cloud-resource inventory remains pending renewal of its expired existing session; this is not proof that a resource is absent. Domain and actual editorial/section criteria are expected later today, so leave them unset and do not repeatedly ask while the user is mobile.

Activation remains pending exact site, owner grant, output/execution, source, billing, retention and infrastructure scope approval. No production write was attempted; there is no denied or uncertain mutation.
